description:
List the node types of the format (type, category, label), optionally for one category. Use it to
        find the type name of a device or load before writing a node; type_info then gives its fields.

category.description: Only the types of this category: source, measure, protection, switching, control, converter, conductor, container, connector or load; default: all.
category.title: Category

lang.description: Language of the returned texts: 'en' (English) or 'fr' (French).
lang.title: Lang

title: List the node types
